questions.q: The total surface area of a solid right circular cylinder is $542\text{ cm}^2$. Its curved surface area is two-fifth of its total surface area. Find the curved surface area of the cylinder.
questions.explain: Given the total surface area (TSA) is $542\text{ cm}^2$ and the curved surface area (CSA) is $\frac{2}{5}$ of the TSA. So, CSA $= \frac{2}{5} \times 542 = 0.4 \times 542 = 216.8\text{ cm}^2$.
